method: Primary documentation and repository license review; not installed-product usability benchmarking. Failed speculative URLs are not counted as evidence.

sources.title: draw.io editor
sources.observation: Context-sensitive panels and distinct editor themes; left palette and right inspector.
sources.design_use: Borrow the visible interaction vocabulary, not an unrestricted styling-first data model.

sources.title: draw.io shape properties
sources.observation: Applicable properties depend on selection; mixed selection exposes common controls.
sources.design_use: Show applicable properties only; avoid the documented thousands-of-properties experience.

sources.title: draw.io connections
sources.observation: Quick append/connect and keyboard alternatives.
sources.design_use: Use contextual append with explicit DDN relation meaning; never split arbitrary references silently.

sources.title: draw.io fixed/floating connectors
sources.observation: Distinguishes attachment to fixed connection points from perimeter connections.
sources.design_use: DDN distinguishes field/port identity from automatic visual anchor freedom.

sources.title: draw.io metadata
sources.observation: Shapes and connectors can carry metadata and separate tooltip behavior.
sources.design_use: DDN metadata remains typed; do not expose all hidden sensitive properties in tooltips.

sources.title: React Flow custom UI and APIs
sources.observation: Node/edge/handle customization, viewport controls, examples and integration API.
sources.design_use: Alternative interaction host; keep DDN scene, router, and canonical source authoritative.

sources.title: React Flow validation
sources.observation: Connection validation is available as an explicit predicate.
sources.design_use: Filter by compatible endpoint types, then validate the actual proposed DDN transaction.

sources.title: React Flow accessibility
sources.observation: Keyboard selection/movement, accessible labels, focus behavior.
sources.design_use: Build full keyboard creation and connection flows; framework features do not certify the finished product.

sources.title: diagram-js architecture via bpmn-js walkthrough
sources.observation: Separates generic canvas/command stack/context pad from domain metamodel and modeling rules.
sources.design_use: Best architectural reference for commands, rules, and contextual construction.

sources.title: diagram-js license
sources.observation: MIT license for diagram-js itself.
sources.design_use: Eligible optional interaction dependency; distinct from bpmn-js licensing.

sources.title: bpmn.io domain toolkit license
sources.observation: bpmn-js and related toolkits require preserving the visible bpmn.io watermark.
sources.design_use: Do not assume generic diagram-js and domain toolkits have identical terms.

sources.title: JointJS ports
sources.observation: First-class port definitions and port groups.
sources.design_use: Separate meaning of a port from its position and visual magnet.

sources.title: JointJS Inspector
sources.observation: Declarative inputs, groups, conditional visibility, validation, and typed controls; example imports @joint/plus.
sources.design_use: Adopt the descriptor-driven approach; do not bundle the commercial Inspector unknowingly.

sources.title: JointJS command history
sources.observation: Batch commands collapse related changes into one undo operation; documented plugin uses @joint/plus.
sources.design_use: One user intent is one DDN source transaction; no second independent history.

sources.title: JointJS licensing
sources.observation: Community library is MPL-2.0; JointJS+ is a separate commercial extension.
sources.design_use: License-check actual selected modules rather than assuming every documented feature is community code.

sources.title: tldraw shape architecture
sources.observation: Validated props and shape utilities separate geometry, rendering, indicators and interaction.
sources.design_use: Reusable geometry + typed descriptors + migrations are valuable patterns.

sources.title: tldraw licensing
sources.observation: SDK is source-available under its own license; production requires an applicable license/key.
sources.design_use: Not the default dependency for a freely redistributable DDN editor.

sources.title: Excalidraw integration
sources.observation: Host callbacks, local scene changes, view modes and optional custom data.
sources.design_use: Borrow compact contextual UX; customData is not a DDN semantic contract.

sources.title: Excalidraw license
sources.observation: MIT license in the inspected repository.
sources.design_use: Suitable reference; replacing DDN export with freehand scene export would lose semantics.

sources.title: yEd partial layout
sources.observation: Selected regions can be laid out without moving the remainder; scope and preferred placement are explicit.
sources.design_use: Provide selected/unpinned/all scopes and preview before applying the existing DDN layouts.

sources.title: Penpot components
sources.observation: Main/copy distinction, linked instances, overrides, reset and explicit update of main.
sources.design_use: Show Shared definition versus This view and show override provenance; never equate a visual occurrence with a physical replica.

sources.title: WCAG dragging movements
sources.observation: SC 2.5.7 requires a single-pointer alternative to nonessential dragging.
sources.design_use: Click-place and click-connect plus keyboard controls are requirements, not follow-up enhancements.

sources.title: WCAG target size
sources.observation: SC 2.5.8 defines minimum target size with exceptions.
sources.design_use: Use at least 24 CSS-pixel hit regions or conforming spacing; prefer 32–44 for creation and touch.

sources.title: WAI toolbar pattern
sources.observation: Toolbar grouping and keyboard navigation guidance.
sources.design_use: Use a labeled toolbar with tested focus behavior and do not hijack shortcuts inside text fields.

sources.title: WAI treeview pattern
sources.observation: Tree semantics, selection and keyboard interaction guidance.
sources.design_use: Provide a searchable keyboard-operable model outline with equivalent commands.

sources.title: Pointer events
sources.observation: Unified mouse/pen/touch input, pointer capture and cancellation.
sources.design_use: Cancel transient geometry cleanly on pointercancel; commit only completed intentions.

sources.title: React Flow license
sources.observation: MIT for the inspected xyflow repository.
sources.design_use: Separate core licensing from paid examples/support and other dependencies.

sources.title: draw.io license
sources.observation: Apache License 2.0 in the inspected branch.
sources.design_use: Do not infer third-party asset or trademark rights; no draw.io source copied into this deliverable.
